## How to send subsequent prompts

Send one numbered prompt at a time, after its required local prerequisites and preceding repair batches pass. An externally blocked human/provider result stays open and still blocks relevant activation/release. Do not mistake a checkpoint file for implemented behavior.

For unfinished work, send:

```text
Continue the current PXX using build-prompts/CONTINUE.md and its revised numbered prompt. Read its latest checkpoint and ADOPTION-DELIVERY.md; execute only the smallest unfinished required batch. Preserve passing work, record A/U results, keep an owned visible preview, commit/push reviewed changes, verify final Git custody, and do not advance automatically.
```

Replace PXX with the current step. P35 order is R1 -> R2 -> R3; P36 order is R1 references -> R2 form editor. R batches are inside the numbered prompts, not separate files.

For the next eligible numbered prompt, send its Execute command from the list below. These commands inherit the first handoff's standing instructions and BUILD-CONTRACT; do not paste the whole list as one execution request. Select the model/effort indicated by the actual prompt in the UI.
